import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { noteComments } from "../../../backend/schema/note_comments";

export const noteCommentsCms = customizeTable<typeof noteComments>("note_comments", {
    icon: "MessageCircle",
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    listFields: ["id", "event", "authorIp", "visible", "note", "author"],
    fields: {
        body: {
            multiline: true,
            markdown: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "event", "authorIp", "visible", "note", "author", "body", "createdAt"]
});
